items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: He was our original clarinetist and we had Bobby Gordon a very fine I would say Joe Marsala type, Pee Wee Russell influenced clarinetist

ctx.x: And who was in your house band while you were there?

Well the first house band involved Jimmy, most of the time Jim Andrews was our piano player and Red Balaban was the bass player. We went through several different drummers, Ronny Cole, Connie Kaye from the MJQ was our drummer for about three years believe it or not, played great drums, in our style, Danny DeImperio, a great drummer from upstate New York came in and did the last three years. I was the cornetist the whole time, the basic one. For a long period of — most of the time was Vic Dickinson on trombone…
And you would just go up — would you go up on the stand and call the tunes as you felt, playing to the crowd somewhat?
